scope: standalone local confirmation page; explicit user actions only; no production integration
requirements: Use frozen gate API to create each confirmed goal and role from an explicit choice.
Full goal inventory remains unverified until user confirms the list.
Multiple confirmed goals require a separate primary-goal choice.
Retain duplicate intent goals as distinct instances with optional user labels.
Question edits invalidate the entire session immediately.
List edits and removals invalidate inventory confirmation, primary focus and candidate outcome.
Stale or tampered clarification requests must fail.
User unsure or outside-scope selections stop the session.
Unknown source facts never grant either branch permission.
Simulated candidate is chosen separately from confirmed facts; never derive candidate from confirmed route.
Keep candidate checks in a clearly labeled simulation panel, separate from user confirmation.
Do not render question text or labels as HTML; no persistence or remote calls.
Verify actual browser behavior and narrow HTTP asset serving; never serve or load evaluation data.
verification: Multiple goals plus explicit primary focus
List editing, removal and stale responses invalidate results
Both branches reject conflicting role candidates
Frozen upstream permissions and all22 fallback scoring preserved
Injected markup stays text; no extra network resources
